title: The Autumn Evan Williams Bought Odeo Back From Its Investors
conflicts: Buyback price never disclosed: Williams told TechCrunch it made investors whole (TechCrunch presumed a little over $5 million); Business Insider says unreported but about $5 million; Fortune says $2 million. Story says only that investors got their money back, as Williams said. Business Insider misdates Apple's iTunes podcasting launch; story gives no date for it.
notes: Some investors' later doubts about what Williams knew of Twitter's prospects are reported attributed, alongside those who called the buyback gracious; no legal finding exists. Noah Glass's firing is reported with his own words; the reasons are disputed and not stated. Williams's own 2006 blog post is cited via the Internet Archive. Stance 'complicates'.
